constellations.desc: Lohen's maximum {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} limit is increased to 300% of its original value.\nAdditionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, they accumulate 500% as much <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color> for him as they originally would have.
constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament

constellations.desc: When in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, after the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.
constellations.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}Unforeseen Strike{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal

constellations.desc:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> while in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, his {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.
constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}Manifest Judgment{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know

constellations.desc: Using the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} and hitting an opponent with it or, while {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, will not consume any {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK}. Instead, Lohen's {LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>Joy</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>, the duration of this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.\nAdditionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color> during this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> is increased by 2.
constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy

passives.desc: When nearby party members accumulate {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>.
passives.name: Moratorium on Questioning

passives.desc: While in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo Reaction</color>, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.
passives.name: Flippant Masterpiece

passives.desc: Lohen gains "High Spirits" for 9s after he unleashes the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color>: Increases the Skill Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color> by 1.\nWhen unleashing an Elemental Skill, if the Level of any other party member's Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst is not lower than Lohen's Elemental Skill Level, the duration of this instance of High Spirits will be increased by an additional 6s.\nHigh Spirits can be gained once every 18s.
passives.name: When the Mood Strikes

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of Various Foes</color>, Lohen becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
When the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, if Lohen's {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} is at 50% or more of its max limit, his Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG will be increased by 40% for 6s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Unhealing Thorn

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath

skills.desc: As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to {LINK#N11290001}Masterstroke{/LINK} mode. While in this state: · Lohen can actively accumulate {LINK#N11290003}Joy{/LINK}, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}Etched Into Bone and Soul{/LINK}. · Nearby party members can accumulate {LINK#N11290004}Will to Win{/LINK} for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy. "Chivalry? Hah, what better way to bait the trap? When an enemy dreams of an honorable victory, they inevitably fail to suspect the 'pleasant surprise' that awaits them."
skills.name: Unforeseen Strike

hyperlinks.description:
Lohen switches to this mode after he unleashes the Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike. Masterstroke mode has the following characteristics:
· DMG dealt by Lohen's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions.
· When Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack, he accumulates Joy that can be used to unleash the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy.
· When nearby party members deal DMG, they also accumulate Will to Win for Lohen that can be used to increase the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
· Masterstroke mode ends when Lohen leaves the field. When Masterstroke mode ends, Joy and Will to Win will be reset to zero.
hyperlinks.name: Masterstroke

hyperlinks.description: A special Elemental Skill that Lohen can use after his Joy reaches the max limit.\nAfter hitting an opponent, consumes all Joy and Will to Win to deal Cryo DMG. This DMG increases based on the amount of Will to Win consumed.
hyperlinks.name: Etched Into Bone and Soul

hyperlinks.description: When Lohen hits opponents with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will accumulate 17 Joy. Up to 100 Joy may be accumulated at any one time.\nJoy can be accumulated once every 0.1s. Once Joy reaches its max limit, Lohen's Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul.
hyperlinks.name: Joy

hyperlinks.description: A special resource accumulated when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in Masterstroke mode. Up to 100 Will to Win may be accumulated at any one time.\nWhile Masterstroke mode is active, when other nearby party members deal DMG, if that DMG is not less than 1000% of Lohen's Base ATK, he accumulates 20 Will to Win. Otherwise, he accumulates 1 Will to Win.\nEach character can accumulate Will to Win for Lohen once every 0.1s.
hyperlinks.name: Will to Win

info.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

info.title: Sharpened Arrowhead

const1.description: 洛恩的{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}上限提升至原来的300%。\n此外，处于{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下时，队伍中附近的其他角色通过造成伤害为洛恩积攒的<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>提升至原来的500%。
const1.name: 往昔微风，载满悲歌

const2.description: 处于{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下时，特殊元素战技{LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>{/LINK}命中敌人或施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>后的4秒内，洛恩将获得「破邪之刃」效果：在奇谋状态下，洛恩的下一次普通攻击或重击命中敌人时，将会额外追加进行一次攻击，造成相当于洛恩攻击力500%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，并使队伍中附近的其他角色的元素精通提升200点，持续8秒，每4秒至多获得一次「破邪之刃」效果。
const2.name: 凡飞翔者，皆为靶标

const3.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}奇兵诡出{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 唯有锋刃，能愈此伤

const4.description:
洛恩在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>时，还会将洛恩的{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}积攒至上限，从而使本次元素爆发获得最高的伤害提升效果。

此外，洛恩切换至<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>状态时，若元素能量：
·未充满：为洛恩恢复15点元素能量；
·已充满：接下来的15秒内，施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>后，为洛恩恢复15点元素能量。
const4.name: 爱若流光，逝如欢歌

const5.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}裁罚遂成{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 无可窥探，无可质疑

const6.description: 施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>{/LINK}命中敌人或在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>不会消耗{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}，并会使洛恩的{LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>欢悦</color>{/LINK}恢复至上限，且在下一次施放特殊元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>命中敌人时，使本次<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>状态的持续时间延长1.25秒，该效果每7秒至多触发一次。\n此外，上述所有伤害的暴击伤害都将提升175%，且本次<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>期间，洛恩施放<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>的最大次数增加2次。
const6.name: 身沦魂销，唯余欢悦

hyperlinks.description:
施放元素战技奇兵诡出后，洛恩将会切换至该状态。奇谋状态具有如下特性：
·洛恩的普通攻击、重击与下落攻击将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的冰元素伤害；
·洛恩的普通攻击或重击命中敌人时，会为洛恩积攒特殊的欢悦，用于施放特殊元素战技镂骨彻心；在奇谋状态下至多施放3次镂骨彻心，之后无法获得欢悦。
·队伍中附近的其他角色造成伤害时，会为洛恩积攒特殊的争胜，用于提升特殊元素战技镂骨彻心造成的伤害；
·洛恩退场时，奇谋状态将会解除；奇谋状态解除时，欢悦与争胜也会清除。
hyperlinks.name: 奇谋

hyperlinks.description: 洛恩的欢悦积攒至上限后，可以施放的特殊元素战技。\n命中敌人后消耗所有欢悦与争胜，造成冰元素伤害，并依据消耗的争胜，提升本次伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 镂骨彻心

hyperlinks.description: 在奇谋状态下，洛恩的普通攻击或重击命中敌人时，会获得17点欢悦，上限为100点。\n每0.1秒至多获得一次欢悦。欢悦积攒至上限后，洛恩的元素战技奇兵诡出将会被替换为特殊的元素战技镂骨彻心。
hyperlinks.name: 欢悦

hyperlinks.description: 在奇谋状态下，队伍中附近的其他角色造成伤害时，会为洛恩提供的特殊资源，上限为100点。\n奇谋状态持续期间，队伍中附近的其他角色造成伤害时，若本次伤害不低于洛恩基础攻击力的1000%，将会为洛恩积攒20点争胜，否则会为洛恩积攒1点争胜。\n同一个角色每0.1秒至多为洛恩积攒一次争胜。
hyperlinks.name: 争胜

info.description: 西风骑士团远程小队副队长，行事不拘一格，钟情于非常规战术的骑士。
info.name: 洛恩
info.title: 恣锐锋镞

p1.description: 在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下，队伍中附近的其他角色通过造成伤害为洛恩积攒{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}时，若本次伤害不低于洛恩基础攻击力的3000%，则还会为洛恩额外积攒60点<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>。
p1.name: 禁问的训诫

p2.description: 在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下，队伍中附近的其他角色对敌人触发<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素相关反应</color>后的8秒内，该角色的攻击力提升15%，洛恩的攻击力提升15%。
p2.name: 戏言的杰作

p3.description: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>奇兵诡出</color>后，洛恩还会获得9秒的「乘兴」效果：持续期间，元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>奇兵诡出</color>的技能等级提高1级。\n施放元素战技时，如果队伍中其他角色的普通攻击、元素战技或元素爆发中，任一技能等级不低于洛恩的元素战技的技能等级，则本次「乘兴」效果的持续时间额外延长6秒。\n每18秒至多获得一次「乘兴」效果。
p3.name: 兴尽且去来

p4.description:
完成<color=#FFD780FF>魔女的课业·诸敌之题</color>后，洛恩将成为<color=#FFD780FF>魔导</color>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。

<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>
特殊元素战技{LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>{/LINK}命中敌人或施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>时，若{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}至少为上限的50%，则洛恩的普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提升40%，持续6秒。
p4.name: 魔女的前夜礼·不愈之刺

elementalburst.description: 向前方快速连续斩击，消耗所有{LINK#N11290004}争胜{/LINK}，造成冰元素伤害，并依据消耗的争胜，提升本次伤害。施放时，若洛恩处于{LINK#N11290001}奇谋{/LINK}状态下，则本次奇谋状态的持续时间还会延长1.65秒。\n\n「这么快就全说了？我都还没尽兴呢。」
elementalburst.name: 裁罚遂成

elementalskill.description: 寻觅敌人的破绽，切换至{LINK#N11290001}奇谋{/LINK}状态。在这种状态下： ·洛恩可以主动积攒{LINK#N11290003}欢悦{/LINK}，从而施放特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11290002}镂骨彻心{/LINK}； ·队伍中附近的其他角色可以为洛恩积攒{LINK#N11290004}争胜{/LINK}，来提高镂骨彻心的伤害。 在奇谋状态下至多施放3次镂骨彻心，之后无法获得欢悦。 「骑士道？哈，那倒确实是绝佳的诱饵。当敌人还幻想着堂堂正正一决胜负时，绝不会想到等待他们的是怎样的『惊喜』。」
elementalskill.name: 奇兵诡出

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多五段的连续攻击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，进行向前的突刺攻击。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 西风枪术·破誓

constellations.desc: Lohen's maximum {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} limit is increased to 300% of its original value.\nAdditionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, they accumulate 500% as much <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color> for him as they originally would have.
constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament

constellations.desc: When in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, after the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.
constellations.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}Unforeseen Strike{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal

constellations.desc:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> while in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, his {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.
constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}Manifest Judgment{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know

constellations.desc: Using the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} and hitting an opponent with it or, while {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color>, will not consume any {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK}. Instead, Lohen's {LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>Joy</color>{/LINK} will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>, the duration of this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.\nAdditionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash <color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color> during this instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color> is increased by 2.
constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy

passives.desc: When nearby party members accumulate {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>.
passives.name: Moratorium on Questioning

passives.desc: While in {LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>Masterstroke</color>{/LINK} mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo Reaction</color>, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.
passives.name: Flippant Masterpiece

passives.desc: Lohen gains "High Spirits" for 9s after he unleashes the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color>: Increases the Skill Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Unforeseen Strike</color> by 1.\nWhen unleashing an Elemental Skill, if the Level of any other party member's Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst is not lower than Lohen's Elemental Skill Level, the duration of this instance of High Spirits will be increased by an additional 6s.\nHigh Spirits can be gained once every 18s.
passives.name: When the Mood Strikes

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of Various Foes</color>, Lohen becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
When the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>Etched Into Bone and Soul</color>{/LINK} hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Manifest Judgment</color> is unleashed, if Lohen's {LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>Will to Win</color>{/LINK} is at 50% or more of its max limit, his Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG will be increased by 40% for 6s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Unhealing Thorn

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath

skills.desc: As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to {LINK#N11290001}Masterstroke{/LINK} mode. While in this state: · Lohen can actively accumulate {LINK#N11290003}Joy{/LINK}, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11290002}Etched Into Bone and Soul{/LINK}. · Nearby party members can accumulate {LINK#N11290004}Will to Win{/LINK} for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy. "Chivalry? Hah, what better way to bait the trap? When an enemy dreams of an honorable victory, they inevitably fail to suspect the 'pleasant surprise' that awaits them."
skills.name: Unforeseen Strike

skills.desc: Performs a swift series of forward strikes, consuming all {LINK#N11290004}Will to Win{/LINK} and dealing Cryo DMG. This DMG will be increased based on the amount of Will to Win consumed. If Lohen is in {LINK#N11290001}Masterstroke{/LINK} mode when this is performed, the duration of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.65s.\n\n"So quick to cave? What a pity, I was just starting to enjoy myself..."
skills.name: Manifest Judgment

constellations.desc: 洛恩的{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}上限提升至原来的300%。\n此外，处于{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下时，队伍中附近的其他角色通过造成伤害为洛恩积攒的<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>提升至原来的500%。
constellations.name: 往昔微风，载满悲歌

constellations.desc: 处于{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下时，特殊元素战技{LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>{/LINK}命中敌人或施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>后的4秒内，洛恩将获得「破邪之刃」效果：在奇谋状态下，洛恩的下一次普通攻击或重击命中敌人时，将会额外追加进行一次攻击，造成相当于洛恩攻击力500%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，并使队伍中附近的其他角色的元素精通提升200点，持续8秒，每4秒至多获得一次「破邪之刃」效果。
constellations.name: 凡飞翔者，皆为靶标

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11292}奇兵诡出{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 唯有锋刃，能愈此伤

constellations.desc:
洛恩在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>时，还会将洛恩的{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}积攒至上限，从而使本次元素爆发获得最高的伤害提升效果。

此外，洛恩切换至<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>状态时，若元素能量：
·未充满：为洛恩恢复15点元素能量；
·已充满：接下来的15秒内，施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>后，为洛恩恢复15点元素能量。
constellations.name: 爱若流光，逝如欢歌

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11295}裁罚遂成{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 无可窥探，无可质疑

constellations.desc: 施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11290002}<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>{/LINK}命中敌人或在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下施放元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>裁罚遂成</color>不会消耗{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}，并会使洛恩的{LINK#N11290003}<color=#FFD780FF>欢悦</color>{/LINK}恢复至上限，且在下一次施放特殊元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>命中敌人时，使本次<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>状态的持续时间延长1.25秒，该效果每7秒至多触发一次。\n此外，上述所有伤害的暴击伤害都将提升175%，且本次<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>期间，洛恩施放<color=#FFD780FF>镂骨彻心</color>的最大次数增加2次。
constellations.name: 身沦魂销，唯余欢悦

passives.desc: 在{LINK#N11290001}<color=#FFD780FF>奇谋</color>{/LINK}状态下，队伍中附近的其他角色通过造成伤害为洛恩积攒{LINK#N11290004}<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>{/LINK}时，若本次伤害不低于洛恩基础攻击力的3000%，则还会为洛恩额外积攒60点<color=#FFD780FF>争胜</color>。
